title: Surface classification, measurement, scale inference, material and semantic labels
summary: Classify every surface into the Bible §4 classes, measure heights/gaps/edges in metres and in A units, infer the per-environment scale multiplier (default 1:12), and attach material and semantic labels via a vision pass.

acceptance_tests.test: The service labels surfaces with the Bible §4 classes and emits measurements and a scale multiplier into scene_graph.json (M1-DATA-01).
Material and semantic labels are attached; the vision pass carries no PII and no location data.
On the corpus, classification is inspected against the Bible §4 examples (couch=walkable-soft, table edge=ledge, chair back=rung, etc.); disagreements are logged to the Bible Field notes.
Schema-validates against scene_graph.json; unit tests cover measurement and A-unit conversion.

history.event: Builder (AUTH #027, gj-scenegraph hat): built the deterministic geometric core in services/scenegraph/ — geometry.py (vec math), segment.py (planar-patch region-grow on the cleaned collision mesh), classify.py (Bible §4 classification + A-unit measurement from orientation/size + the VisionLabeler port with a no-op GeometricStub), scene.py (scale metres→A from the capture bundle's metric scale per SPEC §3.3, environment-local frame with floor at y=0, headroom, spawn, and a reordered collision mesh with one contiguous triangle run per surface), scene_cli.py. Tests: 18 new (geometry/segment/scene), incl. schema-validation of the emitted scene_graph against data/schemas/environment/scene_graph.json, class/scale/spawn/headroom/triangle-run/determinism and the vision-port override; full service suite 29 green; ruff + format clean. AT-4 (schema-validates; measurement + A-unit unit tests) met. AT-1 (labelled render on 5 corpus rooms), AT-2 (material/semantic vision pass) and AT-3 (corpus classification inspection) ride the vision pass, which per SPEC §3.3 must be self-hosted (never off-site) and so is deferred behind the VisionLabeler port — Operator/GPU + corpus. The coarse geometric graph is a valid input to M1-SCEN-03 (traversal edges come from surface height relationships, not the fine class). open → in-progress.

Built the vision-pass survey contract + reference (design/proposals/vision-pass-v1.md; services/scenegraph/scenegraph/vision_survey.py; 14 tests). SurveyVisionLabeler implements the classify.VisionLabeler port, so a self-hosted scene survey adds each patch's material (normalised onto the 11-value scene_graph.material enum via whole-word matching, never a wrong guess -> 'unknown' on a miss) and a coarse semantic (coerced to ^[a-z][a-z-]{1,31}$, never free text) plus an optional Bible §4 class override; validate_survey rejects off-enum/contradictory labels before they reach scene_graph.json. The 'literal survey + per-object material/evidence + liftable/pushable separability + never a compound asset' prompt design is adapted from the MIT image-blaster project; the model stays ours and self-hosted (SPEC §3.3, corpus-only AUTH #031), so AT-1/AT-3 (labelled corpus renders) still ride the Operator/GPU model. The closed material enum + the never-free-text semantic directly serve AT-2 ('no PII/no location, generated labels only'). segmented_objects() exposes the dynamic-object set to M3-GAME-01. No new frozen schema and no protected-path change, so no AUTH. Status stays in-progress.
